appearance_facts.fact: A single teal line connects annual points from 2012 through 2023.
The line generally rises from a low left-side position near y≈585 to a high peak near y≈205.
The final segment slopes downward from the 2022 peak to the 2023 endpoint.
Small local dips are visible, but the overall left-to-right movement remains upward.
